Nam: Anh biết em sẽ vui. Chúng ta sẽ thêm các phòng luyện tập để cung cấp các lớp học nhạc riêng vào cuối năm.

groups.sc:
M: Hi. I'm working on renovating the lobby of my office, and I'd like to get some paint for the walls.
W: Sure. What do you have in mind?
M: Well, I want to paint the walls with one of the colors from our new logo, either green or red.
W: Hmm... I wouldn't choose red—it will fade too fast.
M: Oh, OK. Then let's go with green.
W: Do you have a copy of the logo with you? If I have the image, I can mix a custom paint to match it.
M: Actually, I don't.
W: Well, if you e-mail me a picture of the logo, I can have the paint ready for you by Friday.
groups.vi:
Nam: Chào. Tôi đang cải tạo sảnh văn phòng và muốn mua sơn cho tường.
Nữ: Vâng. Anh nghĩ đến màu gì?
Nam: Tôi muốn dùng một trong các màu từ logo mới, xanh lá hoặc đỏ.
Nữ: Ừm… Tôi sẽ không chọn màu đỏ—nó phai quá nhanh.
Nam: Được, vậy chọn xanh lá.
Nữ: Anh có mang theo bản logo không? Nếu có hình ảnh, tôi có thể pha sơn khớp màu.
Nam: Thực ra là không.
Nữ: Vậy nếu anh gửi ảnh logo qua email, tôi có thể chuẩn bị sơn cho anh vào thứ Sáu.

groups.sc:
W: Welcome to the Western Airlines customer service desk. How can I assist you?
M: Hi. I flew in yesterday from Canada and was told that my luggage was accidentally put on a flight arriving this morning.
W: OK. Do you have your boarding pass?
M: Yes—here it is. Can I go to the unclaimed baggage area and pick up my luggage?
W: That area is past security. I can use information on the boarding pass to locate the luggage for you.
groups.vi:
Nữ: Chào mừng đến với quầy dịch vụ khách hàng của Western Airlines. Tôi có thể giúp gì cho quý khách?
Nam: Chào. Tôi đã bay đến từ Canada ngày hôm qua và được thông báo rằng hành lý của tôi bị vô tình gửi nhầm sang chuyến bay đến vào sáng nay.
Nữ: Vâng. Anh có mang theo thẻ lên máy bay không?
Nam: Có—đây ạ. Tôi có thể đến khu vực hành lý thất lạc để lấy hành lý không?
Nữ: Khu vực đó nằm sau kiểm soát an ninh. Tôi có thể dùng thông tin trên thẻ lên máy bay để tìm hành lý cho anh.

groups.sc:
M: We're so happy to have you join our office as our new dental hygienist, Maria. As you know, you'll be cleaning our patients' teeth before I come in to complete the exam.
W: I'll also be responsible for updating the patients' files and scheduling their next appointments, right?
M: Yes. We use a software program called DentalX for all our patient records. Have you used it before?
W: Yes, I'm familiar with that software.
M: Great. Also, remember that our office closes every day from twelve to one thirty for lunch, so please be mindful of that when scheduling patients.
groups.vi:
Nam: Chúng tôi rất vui khi bạn gia nhập văn phòng với vai trò nha sĩ vệ sinh răng miệng mới, Maria. Bạn sẽ làm sạch răng cho bệnh nhân trước khi tôi vào hoàn tất kiểm tra.
Nữ: Tôi cũng chịu trách nhiệm cập nhật hồ sơ bệnh nhân và lên lịch hẹn tiếp theo, đúng không?
Nam: Đúng. Chúng tôi dùng phần mềm DentalX cho mọi hồ sơ bệnh nhân. Bạn đã dùng chưa?
Nữ: Có, tôi quen với phần mềm đó.
Nam: Tuyệt. Nhớ rằng văn phòng đóng cửa mỗi ngày từ 12 giờ đến 1 giờ 30 để nghỉ trưa, nên hãy lưu ý khi lên lịch hẹn.

groups.sc:
M: Next, I wanted to check with the design team about our water-permeable bricks for walkways. I think the bricks will be popular in areas with water drainage problems. But I'm concerned that the final design won't be ready in time for the trade show.
W1: Right, we still need to finish the durability testing. Camille, how's that going?
W2: So far, they seem to be as durable as we anticipated. But we still have a few more tests to run.
M: Great. Please keep me posted on your progress. In the meantime, we should start putting together a promotional video to show at our booth at the trade show. Who'd like to help me with that project?
groups.vi:
Nam: Tiếp theo, tôi muốn trao đổi với nhóm thiết kế về gạch thấm nước cho lối đi. Loại gạch này sẽ được ưa chuộng ở khu vực có vấn đề thoát nước. Nhưng tôi lo thiết kế cuối cùng không kịp cho hội chợ thương mại.
Nữ 1: Đúng, chúng ta vẫn cần hoàn tất kiểm tra độ bền. Camille, tiến độ thế nào?
Nữ 2: Đến nay chúng bền như dự đoán. Nhưng còn vài bài kiểm tra nữa.
Nam: Tuyệt. Hãy cập nhật tiến độ cho tôi. Trong khi đó, ta nên bắt đầu làm video quảng cáo để chiếu tại gian hàng ở hội chợ. Ai muốn giúp tôi?

groups.sc:
M: Excuse me—officer? Do you happen to know where rideshare drivers park to wait for passengers? It's my first time at this airport.
W: Yes. Drive to the pickup area by terminal A. Look out for the orange sign that says "rideshare." I'm sure you'll see other drivers there. By the way, I recommend taking the terminal bypass. That bridge will take you there faster.
M: Great. Thank you. Oh—is there a fuel station near the airport? My tank is almost empty.
W: You'll see one by the rental-car lot on your way out.
groups.vi:
Nam: Xin lỗi, cảnh sát ạ? Ngài có biết tài xế dịch vụ đi chung xe đậu ở đâu để chờ khách không? Đây là lần đầu tôi đến sân bay này.
Nữ: Có. Lái xe đến khu vực đón khách bên nhà ga A. Tìm biển màu cam có chữ "rideshare". Chắc chắn bạn sẽ thấy các tài xế khác ở đó. Nhân tiện, tôi khuyên đi đường vòng quanh nhà ga. Cây cầu đó đưa bạn đến nhanh hơn.
Nam: Tuyệt. Cảm ơn. À, có trạm xăng gần sân bay không? Bình xăng gần hết.
Nữ: Bạn sẽ thấy một trạm gần bãi thuê xe khi ra khỏi sân bay.

groups.sc:
M: This traffic is really terrible.
W: I know. We've been stuck in this bus for hours now! It's frustrating. I wonder what's going on.
M: I heard the Day Street Bridge is being worked on.
W: Oh, really? I didn't know that.
M: Yes. I think it's down to just one lane for the next couple of weeks.
W: That's good to know. I'll take the train into the city tomorrow instead, so I won't be late for my appointments.
groups.vi:
Nam: Giao thông thật tệ.
Nữ: Tôi biết. Chúng ta kẹt trong xe buýt này mấy giờ rồi! Thật bực mình. Không biết chuyện gì xảy ra.
Nam: Tôi nghe nói cầu Day Street đang sửa chữa.
Nữ: Thật sao? Tôi không biết.
Nam: Đúng. Tôi nghĩ chỉ còn một làn xe trong vài tuần tới.
Nữ: Biết vậy cũng tốt. Ngày mai tôi sẽ đi tàu vào thành phố để không trễ các cuộc hẹn.

groups.sc:
W: Girard Electronics. How can I help you?
M: Hi. I bought a camera from your store last week, but I'm having trouble with it now.
W: What's the problem?
M: Well, I changed the lens from the standard to a telephoto one today, and now an error message pops up on the LCD screen.
W: Hmm. I'm sorry, but I can't know for sure without looking at it, as it could be caused by a few things.
M: I could come by this afternoon.
W: OK. I won't be here, but one of the other employees can definitely help you. Let me just write a note down.
M: Thanks.
groups.vi:
Nữ: Girard Electronics xin nghe. Tôi giúp gì được cho quý khách?
Nam: Chào. Tuần trước tôi mua máy ảnh ở cửa hàng bạn, nhưng giờ gặp sự cố.
Nữ: Vấn đề là gì?
Nam: Hôm nay tôi thay ống kính tiêu chuẩn sang ống kính tele, và giờ màn hình LCD hiện thông báo lỗi.
Nữ: Xin lỗi, tôi không chắc nếu không xem trực tiếp, vì có thể do vài nguyên nhân.
Nam: Chiều nay tôi có thể ghé qua.
Nữ: Được. Tôi sẽ không có ở đây, nhưng nhân viên khác chắc chắn giúp được anh. Để tôi ghi chú lại.
Nam: Cảm ơn.

groups.sc:
M: Hi. I have a delivery of medical supplies addressed to Eun-Mi Park.
W1: That's Eun-Mi sitting at the desk over there.
W2: I'm Eun-Mi, I've been waiting for these sterile pads and bandages.
M: Great. I just need you to sign here to confirm the delivery.
W2: OK, sure. Oh, Claudia, do you have time to help me carry these boxes to the storage closet?
W1: Of course. I have a patient at one o'clock, but I have a few minutes now.
groups.vi:
Nam: Chào. Tôi có lô vật tư y tế gửi đến Eun-Mi Park.
Nữ 1: Eun-Mi đang ngồi ở bàn kia.
Nữ 2: Tôi là Eun-Mi, tôi đang chờ gạc và băng vô trùng này.
Nam: Tuyệt. Chỉ cần bạn ký vào đây để xác nhận giao hàng.
Nữ 2: Được. À Claudia, bạn có thời gian giúp tôi mang các thùng này vào tủ lưu trữ không?
Nữ 1: Dĩ nhiên. Tôi có bệnh nhân lúc 1 giờ, nhưng giờ có vài phút rảnh.

groups.sc:
W: Dula Commercial Cleaners. How can I help you?
M: Hi, I'm running a new bed-and-breakfast in town, and I'm looking for a company to wash, dry, and fold our linens. I have a few questions.
W: Sure.
M: How do you work in terms of scheduling?
W: We work around the clock to guarantee a 24-hour turnaround. We run three separate shifts.
M: That's good to hear.
W: Could I ask where you're located?
M: Oh, we're at 647 Pond Street.
W: In that case, pickup and delivery will not add to your service charge, since you're within a fifteen-kilometer radius of our company.
groups.vi:
Nữ: Dula Commercial Cleaners xin nghe. Tôi giúp gì được cho quý khách?
Nam: Chào, tôi đang vận hành nhà nghỉ bed-and-breakfast mới trong thị trấn, và tìm công ty giặt, sấy, gấp đồ vải. Tôi có vài câu hỏi.
Nữ: Vâng.
Nam: Công ty làm việc thế nào về lịch trình?
Nữ: Chúng tôi làm việc 24/7 để đảm bảo hoàn thành trong 24 giờ. Có ba ca làm việc riêng.
Nam: Nghe tốt quá.
Nữ: Quý vị ở đâu ạ?
Nam: Chúng tôi ở 647 Pond Street.
Nữ: Vậy thì lấy và giao hàng không tính thêm phí, vì quý vị nằm trong bán kính 15km của công ty.

groups.sc:
M: Welcome to Centerville Fitness Center.
W: Hi. I hear you're having a fund-raising campaign.
M: Yes, today's the start of our annual fund-raiser. All proceeds go toward the purchase of new sports equipment for the center. You'll be entered into a raffle to win a prize based on your donation amount.
W: Sounds great. I'd like to donate $50.
M: Wonderful! Just fill out the donation form, and I'll get you your raffle ticket.
W: How will I find out if I won?
M: The drawing's on Friday, and winners will receive a phone call from the organizers.
groups.vi: Nam: Chào mừng đến Trung tâm Thể hình Centerville. Nữ: Tôi nghe nói trung tâm đang gây quỹ. Nam: Đúng, hôm nay là ngày khởi động gây quỹ thường niên. Toàn bộ tiền thu được dùng mua thiết bị thể thao mới. Quý vị được tham gia rút thăm trúng thưởng dựa trên số tiền đóng góp. Nữ: Tôi muốn đóng góp 50 đô la. Nam: Tuyệt! Điền mẫu đóng góp, tôi sẽ đưa vé rút thăm. Nữ: Làm sao biết mình trúng thưởng? Nam: Rút thăm vào thứ Sáu, người trúng thưởng sẽ nhận cuộc gọi từ ban tổ chức.

groups.sc:
W: Hi. Some of us at work decided to get together to buy some flowers here. They're for a colleague who just received a promotion.
M: We have a nice selection of arrangements that are appropriate for an event like that. Here's a list of the most popular, in a range of prices.
W: Oh, I have enough money for the Harmony arrangement. Can you make that while I wait?
M: Sure, I'll have it made for you now. And will you want a greeting card to go with that?
W: Actually, no card is needed. We already have one that we've all signed.
groups.vi: Nữ: Một vài người trong công ty quyết định cùng mua hoa ở đây, tặng đồng nghiệp vừa được thăng chức. Nam: Chúng tôi có nhiều mẫu hoa phù hợp. Đây là danh sách mẫu phổ biến nhất với nhiều mức giá. Nữ: Tôi đủ tiền cho mẫu Harmony. Bạn làm ngay khi tôi chờ được không? Nam: Được, tôi làm ngay. Bạn có muốn kèm thiệp không? Nữ: Không cần, chúng tôi đã có một tấm mà mọi người đã ký.

groups.sc:
W: Hi, Andrew. How have you enjoyed your first week here at Jebreen Farms?
M: It's been great. I'm definitely learning a lot about commercial agriculture.
W: So glad to hear that. Let's go over to where we'll store the upcoming corn harvest. As you know, we sell a lot of corn as feed for livestock farms in the area.
M: Yes. I'm eager to get some hands-on experience with drying and storing the corn.
W: Good. If the process is done right, it can be stored for long periods, but conditions inside the grain bin have to be just right.
M: How long will the drying process take after the harvest?
W: About four to six weeks.
groups.vi: Nữ: Chào Andrew. Tuần đầu ở Jebreen Farms thế nào? Nam: Rất tuyệt, tôi học được nhiều về nông nghiệp thương mại. Nữ: Ta đến nơi sẽ lưu trữ vụ ngô sắp tới. Chúng tôi bán nhiều ngô làm thức ăn cho trang trại chăn nuôi trong vùng. Nam: Tôi háo hức có kinh nghiệm thực tế về sấy và lưu trữ ngô. Nữ: Làm đúng thì ngô lưu trữ được lâu, nhưng điều kiện trong silo phải hoàn hảo. Nam: Sấy sau thu hoạch mất bao lâu? Nữ: Khoảng bốn đến sáu tuần.

groups.sc: M: Welcome to your first day of work at Schneider Technology. Our navigation devices enable vehicles to direct drivers to their destination by taking into consideration a variety of factors such as distance, weather, and traffic conditions. Moritz Schneider, the president of the company, will be here in person at ten o'clock to welcome you and tell you all about the company's history. But first, I'll help you set up your computer accounts. Cybersecurity is very important to us, so we've added extra steps to verify your identity.
groups.vi: Chào mừng ngày làm việc đầu tiên tại Schneider Technology. Thiết bị định vị của chúng tôi giúp xe hướng dẫn lái xe đến đích, có xét khoảng cách, thời tiết, giao thông. Chủ tịch Moritz Schneider sẽ có mặt lúc mười giờ để chào mừng và giới thiệu lịch sử công ty. Trước tiên tôi giúp bạn thiết lập tài khoản máy tính. An ninh mạng rất quan trọng nên có thêm các bước xác minh danh tính.

groups.sc: W: Good afternoon. This is Captain Jeong giving you a heads-up on our plane's departure status. As you can see, there's a light dusting of snow on the ground. Air traffic control is holding us here at the gate while the snowplows clear the runway. It should take just a few minutes, then we'll be cleared for takeoff. I apologize for the delay. And a reminder: please ensure that children remain seated with their seat belts fastened throughout the flight.
groups.vi: Chào buổi chiều. Tôi là cơ trưởng Jeong, thông báo tình trạng khởi hành. Trên mặt đất có lớp tuyết mỏng. Kiểm soát không lưu giữ chúng ta tại cổng trong khi xe dọn tuyết làm sạch đường băng. Chỉ mất vài phút, sau đó được phép cất cánh. Xin lỗi vì chậm trễ. Nhắc lại: đảm bảo trẻ em ngồi yên với dây an toàn thắt chặt suốt chuyến bay.

groups.sc: M: Good morning, and thanks for tuning in to News at Four. We've just learned that the Natural Zoological Museum, one of Springfield's most popular museums, will soon close for a renovation project. To those who are planning to visit the exhibits in person, be aware that the workers arrive in six weeks. But if you miss that window, don't worry. You can still visit the museum virtually during the renovation period. Video tours will soon be available on the museum's Web site, and videos showing the progress of the project will also be posted regularly.
groups.vi: Nam: Chào buổi sáng, cảm ơn quý vị đã theo dõi bản Tin tức Lúc Bốn Giờ. Bảo tàng Động vật Học Tự nhiên, một trong những bảo tàng nổi tiếng nhất của Springfield, sẽ sớm đóng cửa để cải tạo. Ai định tham quan trực tiếp xin lưu ý công nhân sẽ đến sau sáu tuần nữa. Nếu bỏ lỡ cũng đừng lo, bạn vẫn có thể tham quan trực tuyến trong thời gian cải tạo. Các chuyến tham quan bằng video sẽ sớm có trên trang web của bảo tàng, và video cập nhật tiến độ dự án cũng sẽ được đăng thường xuyên.

groups.sc: W: At Jin-Ah's Jewelers, we create custom-made jewelry that showcases your style and celebrates the most important moments in your life. Meet for a video consultation with one of our talented artists, who can design earrings, bracelets, and more, just for you. And unlike our competitors, who only send you a sketch, we'll send you a simple metal prototype. You can approve or request changes to the sample before your final piece is made. To get your order started, just enter your information on our Web site, and one of our designers will contact you.
groups.vi: Nữ: Tại Jin-Ah's Jewelers, chúng tôi tạo ra trang sức làm theo yêu cầu, thể hiện phong cách của bạn và kỷ niệm những khoảnh khắc quan trọng nhất trong đời. Hẹn gặp trực tuyến với một nghệ nhân tài năng, người có thể thiết kế bông tai, vòng tay và nhiều món khác dành riêng cho bạn. Khác với đối thủ chỉ gửi bản phác thảo, chúng tôi sẽ gửi một mẫu kim loại đơn giản. Bạn có thể duyệt hoặc yêu cầu thay đổi mẫu trước khi sản phẩm cuối cùng được chế tác. Để bắt đầu đơn hàng, chỉ cần nhập thông tin trên trang web, một nhà thiết kế sẽ liên hệ với bạn.

groups.sc: M: On today's episode of our podcast, we'll be talking to Rebecca Taylor, the chair and founder of Real Estate Investments LLC. As we know, the housing market has had its ups and downs in recent years. Ms. Taylor is widely known for her ability to correctly predict trends in the real estate market. Her opinion is highly valued. We are fortunate to be able to interview her today before she travels to the National Real Estate Conference in Chicago, where she has been invited to deliver the keynote speech.
groups.vi: Nam: Trong tập podcast hôm nay, chúng tôi trò chuyện với Rebecca Taylor, chủ tịch kiêm người sáng lập Real Estate Investments LLC. Thị trường bất động sản đã trải qua những thăng trầm những năm gần đây. Bà Taylor nổi tiếng với khả năng dự đoán chính xác xu hướng thị trường bất động sản, ý kiến của bà được đánh giá rất cao. Chúng tôi may mắn được phỏng vấn bà trước khi bà tham dự Hội nghị Bất động sản Quốc gia tại Chicago, nơi bà được mời đọc bài phát biểu chính.

groups.sc: W: The topic for today's workshop is writing business correspondence. Business correspondence has different guidelines than the informal type of writing you use when writing to a friend. For example, when writing to a friend you might address them by their first name or perhaps include emojis. You know—symbols like smiley faces that are commonly used to express feelings. However, emojis are considered inappropriate in business writing. Also, business correspondence should always include the recipient's title and last name. Remember, we don't want to offend our clients. Now, I will project some slides of informally worded e-mails. In your notebooks, rewrite the e-mails using wording and style appropriate for business correspondence.
groups.vi: Nữ: Chủ đề buổi hội thảo hôm nay là viết thư từ công việc. Thư từ công việc có hướng dẫn khác với cách viết không chính thức khi viết cho bạn bè. Ví dụ, với bạn bè bạn có thể gọi bằng tên riêng hoặc dùng emoji, những biểu tượng như mặt cười thể hiện cảm xúc. Tuy nhiên emoji không phù hợp trong văn bản công việc. Ngoài ra, thư từ công việc luôn phải có chức danh và họ của người nhận. Hãy nhớ, chúng ta không muốn làm phật lòng khách hàng. Bây giờ tôi sẽ trình chiếu một số email viết không chính thức. Trong sổ tay, hãy viết lại các email đó bằng cách diễn đạt và phong cách phù hợp với thư từ công việc.

groups.sc: W: In the world of business, athletic retailer Clementine Stores has filed a complaint against software firm Stephion. Clementine claims that the Stephion logo, which is round and orange, is too similar to its own. However, a Stephion public relations representative, Friedrich Weber, responded by saying that the two company logos were similar but not similar enough to confuse consumers. Furthermore, Weber maintained that the Stephion design was not problematic because the two companies are in completely different markets. Our in-house legal analyst will join us next.
groups.vi: Nữ: Trong thế giới kinh doanh, chuỗi cửa hàng thể thao Clementine Stores đã nộp đơn khiếu nại công ty phần mềm Stephion. Clementine cho rằng logo tròn màu cam của Stephion quá giống logo của họ. Tuy nhiên, đại diện quan hệ công chúng của Stephion, Friedrich Weber, nói hai logo giống nhưng không đủ để gây nhầm lẫn cho khách hàng. Weber còn khẳng định thiết kế không gây vấn đề vì hai công ty hoạt động ở các thị trường hoàn toàn khác nhau. Chuyên viên phân tích pháp lý nội bộ của chúng tôi sẽ tham gia ngay sau đây.

groups.sc: M: Thanks for coming in early this morning. I wanted to update you on the café refrigerators that our customers use. We recently installed a new temperature monitoring system. I've noticed that every increase in temperature can be traced to the refrigerator doors being left open for extended periods of time. This is alarming because it compromises the freshness and safety of our food. We all know that customers often take a while to make their selection. I'll be meeting with the management team to discuss ways to address this.
groups.vi: Nam: Cảm ơn các bạn đã đến sớm sáng nay. Tôi muốn cập nhật về tủ lạnh tại quán cà phê mà khách hàng sử dụng. Gần đây chúng tôi lắp hệ thống giám sát nhiệt độ mới. Tôi nhận thấy mỗi lần nhiệt độ tăng đều do cửa tủ lạnh bị để mở lâu. Điều này đáng lo ngại vì ảnh hưởng đến độ tươi và an toàn của thực phẩm. Chúng ta đều biết khách hàng thường mất một lúc để chọn món. Tôi sẽ họp với ban quản lý để thảo luận cách giải quyết.

groups.sc: W: First, I'd like to welcome our new employees. Won-Sang Kwon has joined the human resources department as a junior associate, and So-Jin Cho is our newest chief of building security. Welcome! Next, I want to inform everyone about an upcoming recommended safety workshop. Links to the registration form have been e-mailed. When filling out the registration form, you do not need to fill in the street address. Leave that field blank. Do enter your work e-mail in the appropriate place. Finally, don't forget that the cafeteria will be closed next week, so you'll need to bring your lunch.
groups.vi: Nữ: Trước tiên, tôi muốn chào mừng các nhân viên mới. Won-Sang Kwon đã gia nhập phòng nhân sự với vai trò cộng sự cấp dưới, và So-Jin Cho là trưởng bộ phận an ninh tòa nhà mới nhất của chúng ta. Chào mừng các bạn! Tiếp theo, tôi muốn thông báo đến mọi người về một buổi hội thảo về an toàn sắp tới được khuyến nghị. Liên kết đến mẫu đăng ký đã được gửi qua email. Khi điền vào mẫu đăng ký, bạn không cần điền địa chỉ đường phố. Hãy để trống ô đó. Nhưng hãy nhập email công việc của bạn vào vị trí thích hợp. Cuối cùng, đừng quên rằng căng tin sẽ đóng cửa vào tuần tới, vì vậy bạn sẽ cần mang theo bữa trưa.

groups.sc: M: Hi, Marta. This is Oleg from Sola Salon returning your call. You wanted to know about my availability for haircuts—yes, I am accepting new clients. This week, I can fit you in on Wednesday at four o'clock. Please let me know whether that day and time work for you. And in case you didn't know, there's a parking garage with reasonable rates right under our building. A full styling session takes about one and a half hours, so you won't need to park for more than two hours in the garage.
groups.vi: Nam: Chào Marta. Tôi là Oleg từ Sola Salon, gọi lại cho bạn. Bạn muốn biết về lịch rảnh của tôi để cắt tóc—vâng, tôi đang nhận khách mới. Tuần này, tôi có thể sắp xếp cho bạn vào lúc 4 giờ chiều thứ Tư. Hãy cho tôi biết liệu ngày giờ đó có phù hợp với bạn không. Và nếu bạn chưa biết, có một bãi đậu xe với mức phí hợp lý ngay dưới tòa nhà của chúng tôi. Một buổi làm tóc đầy đủ mất khoảng một tiếng rưỡi, vì vậy bạn không cần phải gửi xe hơn hai tiếng trong bãi.

Gửi: Tất cả nhân viên kho. Từ: Paul Wandayi, Quản lý kho. Ngày: 15 tháng 3. V/v: Các thùng chứa mới sắp được đưa vào sử dụng. Bắt đầu từ ngày 1 tháng 4, Windquest Farms sẽ dùng thùng Flexmerge để vận chuyển trái cây và rau củ. Những [131] sẽ đơn giản hóa công việc và giảm chi phí vận hành. Thùng Flexmerge gập gọn được, dễ xếp chồng và tiết kiệm không gian – [132]. Chúng cũng rất bền, giảm nhu cầu [133] thay thế thùng thường xuyên. Cuối cùng, chúng có thiết kế công thái học, [134] nguy cơ chấn thương. An toàn là ưu tiên hàng đầu của Windquest Farms.

Chương trình truyền hình ăn khách trở lại với mùa thứ ba. Chủ nhật đánh dấu mùa thứ ba của loạt phim đoạt giải King of the Meer. Bộ phim chính trị – giật gân này [135] dựa trên cuốn Whispered Illusions của Noriaki Arishima. Một số nhà phê bình tin mùa ba có thể hay hơn các mùa trước. [136], những người khác cho rằng phim có thể mất sức hút vì quá nhiều nhân vật mới, khiến cốt truyện phức tạp khó hiểu. Đạo diễn Amber Randolph phản hồi lại [137] đó: "Nhiều nhân vật mới có thể khiến câu chuyện khó theo dõi. [138]. Chúng ta sẽ xem người hâm mộ nghĩ gì."

Gửi: Jee-Wah Cho. Từ: Ken Belfant. Ngày: 6 tháng 4. Chủ đề: Cuộc thi công thức nấu ăn. Kính gửi cô Cho, cảm ơn cô vì [139] công thức thú vị dùng kem phủ đánh bông Fluffy Time ít béo, không đường. [140] đã được đưa vào cuộc thi sắp tới. Công thức thắng cuộc sẽ xuất hiện trên bao bì sản phẩm. [141]. Trong thời gian chờ, tôi sẽ gửi cô phiếu giảm giá 25% cho lần mua tiếp theo qua email riêng mà cô sẽ nhận [142]. Chúc cô may mắn! Ken Belfant, Điều phối viên khuyến mãi, Fluffy Time Industries.

Bingo Imprint tạo thiết kế cho sản phẩm quảng bá như sổ tay, nam châm dán tủ lạnh, quần áo. Khách hàng tự quyết mức độ tham gia vào quá trình thiết kế. [143], một số khách gửi bản phác thảo chi tiết. Những người khác hoàn toàn [144] hài lòng khi để họa sĩ đồ họa của chúng tôi phát triển thiết kế. Khi hoàn thiện, thiết kế được gửi khách phê duyệt. [145]. Chúng tôi đảm bảo hoàn thành trong năm ngày làm việc kể từ khi đặt đơn. Bạn có thể tin cậy [146] Bingo Imprint về thiết kế độc đáo, giá cạnh tranh và giao hàng đúng hạn.

Khảo sát mức độ hài lòng – Crystal Brothers. Cảm ơn quý khách đã thuê Crystal Brothers vệ sinh tòa nhà. Khoanh tròn số từ 5 = "Rất tốt" đến 1 = "Kém"; "NP" cho loại phòng không có tại địa điểm. Khách hàng: Geraldine Hwang. Ngày: 22 tháng 2. Dịch vụ vệ sinh: phòng khách, nhà bếp, phòng ăn, phòng ngủ, sảnh, phòng họp (thang 5–1, NP). Thông tin khác: đặt lịch hẹn có dễ không; nhân viên có làm theo hướng dẫn cụ thể không; có cung cấp thông tin trước khi đến không; chi phí có như mong đợi không (thang 5–1).

Giao hàng sản phẩm: Hampton Landscaping giao sản phẩm cảnh quan (đất mặt, phân trộn, sỏi, mùn vỏ cây, củi, hỗn hợp trồng cây) đến nhà ở hoặc cơ sở kinh doanh, khối lượng lớn và nhỏ, thứ Hai đến thứ Bảy. Phí thay đổi theo khối lượng, loại sản phẩm, địa điểm; gọi 904-555-0132. Khách không cần có mặt, nhưng khu vực giao hàng phải có lối vào phù hợp cho xe tải, nếu không áp dụng phí nhập kho lại 50 USD.

Hannah Fisk (1:18): Nhờ Frank kiểm tra báo cáo ngân sách trước khi nộp phòng Kế toán chiều nay. Frank (1:20): Cho tôi khoảng 45 phút, đang cập nhật báo cáo hiệu suất hàng tháng. Hannah (1:22): Không sao, tôi sẽ kiểm tra lại dữ liệu chi phí. Frank (1:24): Ý hay, các ước tính đó khó xử lý. Hannah (1:25): Tôi ghé văn phòng anh lúc 2:30 được không? Frank (1:26): Hoàn hảo.

E-mail từ Travel Today gửi Seo-Yun Jang, ngày 18/3, thông báo giá vé: vé giá thấp thường có hạn nên nên đặt sớm; liên hệ 210-555-0137. Chuyến 1: Seattle–Chicago 28/7, một chiều, phổ thông: Nomata (1 điểm dừng Denver) 315 USD; Blue Range (bay thẳng) 376 USD. Chuyến 2: Los Angeles–New York 15/8, comfort-plus: Nomata (dừng Houston) 385 USD; Blue Range (bay thẳng) 436 USD.

E-mail Sasha Lombardo gửi Rogelio Garza, 18/1, về sách nấu ăn tự xuất bản: gửi bản nháp mới nhất, cảm ơn đã xem các công thức xem có dễ làm theo không. Một số người cho biết vài hướng dẫn khó hiểu. Nhờ ghi nhận xét ở phần lề để cùng một tài liệu. Các khung có X đỏ là nhắc thay bằng ảnh tốt hơn sau này.

Thư ngày 23/3 gửi bà Priscilla Yamaguchi (Berlin) từ Aqua Voyage Cruise Lines: sẽ mở rộng đội tàu vào tháng Bảy, muốn hợp tác với chuỗi nhà hàng Saffron Moon của bà. Lợi ích: nhiều đối tượng khách hơn, giới thiệu trong brochure và website, giúp đàm phán giá thấp cho nguyên liệu và thiết bị nhà hàng.

KMC đạt thành tựu lớn (Tây Úc, 21/6): ngày 19/6 Trung tâm Y tế Karinya nhận Giải thưởng Stellar Service Merit của Quỹ Valorcare, với tiêu chí gồm chăm sóc kịp thời, kết quả điều trị vượt trội, đào tạo nhân viên, bệnh nhân rất hài lòng. Chủ tịch Lee Cinder chúc mừng. CEO Linh Nguyen (nhậm chức tháng Ba năm ngoái) nói KMC là một trong bảy bệnh viện được vinh danh, giải thưởng phản ánh cam kết đặt sức khỏe bệnh nhân lên hàng đầu, và KMC đã duy trì tiêu chuẩn cao suốt 47 năm.

Chat nhóm: Alexa Balog trực cứu hộ Công viên Rosemoor thay Jamie Kerr, phải đóng hồ bơi vì mưa. Maxwell Diego nói quy định của Pool Guardian là chờ 30 phút sau khi hết thời tiết xấu. Balog nói từ 2:30 không có ai, xin đóng hồ. Wade Nolan từ chối vì hợp đồng yêu cầu có cứu hộ đến 5 giờ chiều thứ Năm. Balog đang dọn kho thiết bị; nếu sau 4:30 mưa lớn thì đóng cửa.

Trang web Sagemont Services: cung cấp giải pháp CNTT theo nhu cầu, thành lập hơn 20 năm trước, nay dẫn đầu ngành. Gần đây giúp nhiều doanh nghiệp hoàn thành dự án gấp rút. Ví dụ Clothing Discounters mở rộng nhanh, Sagemont trang bị thiết bị và kết nối trong hai ngày để nhân viên mới xử lý cuộc gọi từ nhà. Xem thêm trang Client Testimonials.

Bài báo: nhà điêu khắc Ida Alonso triển lãm Throwaways into Treasure tại MCAC đến 4/11, dùng vật liệu tái chế. Ý tưởng từ bài đọc về ghế công viên bằng nhựa tái chế. Khách có thể mang đồ nhựa đến bỏ vào túi thu gom. Ngày cuối, vật liệu gửi đến Flyner Industries làm vật liệu rèm chống nước. MCAC mở 10:00–17:00, vào cửa miễn phí, có trưng bày tác phẩm sinh viên.

Bảng khảo sát Superb Hotels (Lisbon) tháng 6: phòng 91% (+8%), bữa sáng 82% (+10%), lễ tân 80% (-5%), tổng thể 87% (+7%); dữ liệu do Naomi Akdemir, Customer Solutions, Exelrate. Bài báo 3/7: Exelrate xây trụ sở mới tại Toronto, do phó chủ tịch Rosa Martin chỉ đạo sau khi xong việc ở Frankfurt cuối tháng; tòa nhà do Frank Tsudama thiết kế.

Thông báo: Siêu thị Richmond tổ chức lớp nấu ăn tại bếp riêng, mỗi tối thứ Hai 7:00–8:30 tối với đầu bếp khách mời. Lịch tháng 8: 2/8 Gà bơ (Ấn Độ), 9/8 Pad Thai (Thái Lan), 16/8 Taco cá (Mexico), 23/8 Lasagna rau củ nướng (Ý). Học phí 55 đô la/lớp, đăng ký qua 604-555-0175 hoặc www.richmondsupermarket.ca, tối đa 15 học viên. Đánh giá của Astrid Klein: tuần trước học làm taco cá với bếp trưởng Mateo Bernal, tự làm bánh tortilla bắp, cá rô phi nướng, salsa tomatillo, nhận sổ công thức; cô sẽ sắp xếp các tối thứ Hai để quay lại nhiều lần nữa.

Bài báo (York, 17/1): Viện Mắt Callard thông báo bà Jennifer Robbins nhận chức trưởng khoa, có hiệu lực ngay. Bà lớn lên ở York, học Trường Y Labato, nội trú sau tiến sĩ tại Trung tâm Y tế Petersen, từng sáng lập phòng khám nhãn khoa tại Bệnh viện Morseville. Ngày 17/4 bà nhận Huy chương Kramer tại hội nghị ICVA ở Berlin. Chương trình ngày 17/4: 10:00–11:00 phát biểu khai mạc; 9:00–9:30 tối tráng miệng và trao giải tại Regal Ballroom. E-mail 22/4 của Paulina Raskin gửi Dr. Sohn cảm ơn bài phát biểu khai mạc tại hội nghị.

Trang web Freewheel Oasis: hai chương trình đổi xe và ký gửi. Gửi e-mail đặt hẹn; quản lý dịch vụ khách hàng phản hồi. Kỹ thuật viên đánh giá tình trạng xe, nhân viên bán hàng định giá; ký gửi giữ phí 15% khi bán được. Nicola Johnson (2/11) muốn ký gửi xe địa hình 6 năm tuổi, sắp đi Kuwait ngày 30/11, hỏi cách nhận tiền. Phản hồi: hẹn thứ Sáu 4/11 lúc 3:00 chiều; tiền chuyển vào tài khoản ngân hàng sau khi bán; không đảm bảo bán trước ngày cụ thể.

(Phần cuối danh sách) 1. Giấy tờ chứng minh danh tính (bản sao bằng lái xe, hộ chiếu hoặc giấy tờ tùy thân chính thức khác). 2. Phiếu thông tin cá nhân. 3. Biểu mẫu khấu trừ thuế. 4. Biểu mẫu thông tin tài khoản ngân hàng. 5. Biểu mẫu lựa chọn bảo hiểm. 6. Biểu mẫu miễn trừ trách nhiệm (nếu được yêu cầu). E-mail 2 (Yumiko Kuroda → Simon Cady): Tôi không lái xe nên không có bằng lái, nhưng có thể cung cấp bản sao trang thông tin trong hộ chiếu. Tôi đang chuẩn bị thu thập thông tin cần thiết cho mục thứ tư trong danh sách và sẽ mang tất cả đến văn phòng vào thứ Hai. Tôi sẽ phải suy nghĩ về việc có tham gia đội softball của công ty hay không. Buổi dã ngoại của công ty nghe có vẻ rất vui. Tôi rất thích công viên Briarwood và mong có cơ hội hiểu rõ đồng nghiệp hơn. Nếu nhân viên mang món ăn đến buổi picnic, tôi sẵn sàng chuẩn bị một món.

To: All Warehouse Employees
From: Paul Wandayi, Warehouse Manager
Date: 15 March
Re: New crates coming

Beginning 1 April, Windquest Farms will use Flexmerge crates to transport our fruits and vegetables. These ___(131)___ will simplify work and shrink operational costs.

Flexmerge crates are collapsible, which means they are easy to stack and they save space. ___(132)___. They are also highly durable. This feature minimizes the need ___(133)___ frequent replacement of crates. Finally, they are designed with ergonomic features, thereby ___(134)___ the risk of injuries. Safety is our top priority here at Windquest Farms.
docs.vi:
Gửi: Toàn thể nhân viên kho
Từ: Paul Wandayi, Quản lý kho
Ngày: 15 tháng 3
V/v: Sắp có thùng mới

Bắt đầu từ ngày 1 tháng 4, Windquest Farms sẽ sử dụng thùng Flexmerge để vận chuyển trái cây và rau củ của chúng ta. Những ___(131)___ này sẽ đơn giản hóa công việc và cắt giảm chi phí vận hành.

Thùng Flexmerge có thể gấp gọn, nghĩa là chúng dễ xếp chồng và tiết kiệm không gian. ___(132)___. Chúng cũng rất bền. Đặc điểm này giảm thiểu nhu cầu ___(133)___ thay thùng thường xuyên. Cuối cùng, chúng được thiết kế với các tính năng công thái học, nhờ đó ___(134)___ nguy cơ chấn thương. An toàn là ưu tiên hàng đầu của chúng ta tại Windquest Farms.

docs.text:
Popular TV Show Returns for Third Season

Sunday marks the start of the third season of the award-winning TV series King of the Meer. This political thriller ___(135)___ on the book Whispered Illusions by Noriaki Arishima.

Some reviewers of the television series believe that the third season might be even better than the previous ones. ___(136)___, other reviewers argue that the series might lose its appeal with the introduction of so many new characters, resulting in a complicated and confusing plotline.

Director Amber Randolph has responded to that ___(137)___. "The abundance of new characters can make the story challenging to follow," she said. "___(138)___. We'll see what the fans of the show think."
docs.vi:
Chương trình truyền hình nổi tiếng trở lại với mùa thứ ba

Chủ nhật đánh dấu sự khởi đầu của mùa thứ ba của loạt phim truyền hình từng đoạt giải King of the Meer. Bộ phim kinh dị chính trị này ___(135)___ dựa trên cuốn sách Whispered Illusions của Noriaki Arishima.

Cảm ơn anh một lần nữa!

Sasha

KMC Scores Major Triumph

WESTERN AUSTRALIA (21 June)—On 19 June, Western Australia's Karinya Medical Centre (KMC) was awarded the Valorcare Foundation's Stellar Service Merit, regarded as one of the highest honours an Australian hospital can receive. To qualify for the award, hospitals must meet a set of criteria, including timely access to care, superior medical outcomes, extensive staff training, and exceptional patient satisfaction.

"Congratulations to KMC's board of directors, management, and staff," said Lee Cinder, president of the Valorcare Foundation. "The centre has consistently demonstrated dedication to high-quality care; therefore, we are pleased to recognise it this year as one of the nation's outstanding medical facilities."

Dr. Linh Nguyen, who became CEO of KMC last March, said, "We are extremely proud that KMC is among the seven hospitals in the country recognised by the Valorcare Foundation. This award reflects our commitment to putting patient well-being at the forefront of everything we do. Since KMC opened its doors, we have set high patient care standards and strive to maintain this goal every year. For 47 years now, I believe we have been quite successful in this endeavour."

TÂY ÚC (21 tháng 6)—Vào ngày 19 tháng 6, Trung tâm Y tế Karinya (KMC) của Tây Úc đã được Quỹ Valorcare trao tặng Giải thưởng Dịch vụ Xuất sắc Stellar, được xem là một trong những vinh dự cao nhất mà một bệnh viện Úc có thể nhận được. Để đủ điều kiện nhận giải, các bệnh viện phải đáp ứng một loạt tiêu chí, bao gồm khả năng tiếp cận dịch vụ chăm sóc kịp thời, kết quả điều trị vượt trội, đào tạo nhân viên toàn diện và sự hài lòng xuất sắc của bệnh nhân.

"Xin chúc mừng hội đồng quản trị, ban quản lý và toàn thể nhân viên của KMC," ông Lee Cinder, chủ tịch Quỹ Valorcare, cho biết. "Trung tâm đã liên tục thể hiện sự tận tâm với chất lượng chăm sóc cao; vì vậy, chúng tôi vui mừng ghi nhận trung tâm trong năm nay là một trong những cơ sở y tế xuất sắc của quốc gia."

Bác sĩ Linh Nguyen, người trở thành Giám đốc điều hành của KMC vào tháng 3 vừa qua, cho biết: "Chúng tôi vô cùng tự hào khi KMC nằm trong số bảy bệnh viện của cả nước được Quỹ Valorcare ghi nhận. Giải thưởng này phản ánh cam kết của chúng tôi trong việc đặt sức khỏe của bệnh nhân lên hàng đầu trong mọi việc chúng tôi làm. MCAC to Exhibit Alonso's Works

MAURELY CITY (August 29)—Using recycled materials has become popular with artists, and local sculptor Ida Alonso has happily embraced this trend. Her new exhibition, Throwaways into Treasure, runs from today until November 4 at the Maurely City Art Center (MCAC).
Ms. Alonso had the idea for the project while reading about recycled plastic being made into park benches in the Journal for Professional Landscape Architects. She then began to collect old plastic bottles and cardboard shipping boxes and innovatively combined them with commercially made, recyclable building materials.

For the exhibition, Ms. Alonso has created a life-size imitation of commercial offices, with cubicles and partitions made from recovered materials. "By means of my synthetic office space, I am hoping to highlight the idea that old, unwanted objects can take on a new purpose," Ms. Alonso said. Guests who attend the art show will have the opportunity to bring in their own recyclable plastic items and place them in large collection bags set up around the perimeter of the exhibition room. Ms. Alonso also plans to add more recyclable material to her installation as the show progresses.

Although MCAC will be the only venue for Ms. Alonso's show, the exhibition is expected to travel in a different sense. On the exhibition's final day, the works will be dismantled, and all the recyclable materials, including the items brought by visitors, will be transported to a Flyner Industries facility, where they will be shredded and transformed into material for waterproof curtains.

MCAC is open daily from 10:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M. Admission to the art center is free. In addition to Ms. Alonso's show, works by several local art students will be on view in MCAC's main gallery.

MCAC sẽ trưng bày các tác phẩm của Alonso

THÀNH PHỐ MAURELY (29/8)—Việc sử dụng vật liệu tái chế đã trở nên phổ biến với các nghệ sĩ, và nhà điêu khắc địa phương Ida Alonso đã vui vẻ đón nhận xu hướng này. Triển lãm mới của bà, Throwaways into Treasure, diễn ra từ hôm nay đến ngày 4/11 tại Trung tâm Nghệ thuật Thành phố Maurely (MCAC).
Bà Alonso nảy ra ý tưởng cho dự án khi đọc về việc nhựa tái chế được làm thành ghế công viên trên tạp chí Journal for Professional Landscape Architects. Sau đó bà bắt đầu thu gom chai nhựa cũ và thùng các-tông vận chuyển, rồi kết hợp chúng một cách sáng tạo với các vật liệu xây dựng tái chế được sản xuất thương mại.

Cho triển lãm này, bà Alonso đã tạo ra một bản mô phỏng văn phòng thương mại với kích thước thật, có các ô làm việc và vách ngăn làm từ vật liệu thu hồi. "Thông qua không gian văn phòng nhân tạo này, tôi hy vọng nhấn mạnh ý tưởng rằng những đồ vật cũ, không còn cần đến có thể mang một mục đích mới," bà Alonso nói. Khách đến xem triển lãm sẽ có cơ hội mang theo đồ nhựa tái chế của riêng mình và bỏ vào các túi thu gom lớn được đặt xung quanh phòng triển lãm. Bà Alonso cũng dự định bổ sung thêm vật liệu tái chế vào tác phẩm sắp đặt của mình khi triển lãm diễn ra.

Mặc dù MCAC sẽ là địa điểm duy nhất cho triển lãm của bà Alonso, triển lãm này dự kiến sẽ "di chuyển" theo một nghĩa khác. Vào ngày cuối cùng của triển lãm, các tác phẩm sẽ được tháo dỡ, và toàn bộ vật liệu tái chế, bao gồm cả những món do khách tham quan mang đến, sẽ được vận chuyển đến một cơ sở của Flyner Industries, nơi chúng sẽ được nghiền nhỏ và chuyển thành vật liệu làm rèm chống thấm nước.

MCAC mở cửa hằng ngày từ 10:00 sáng đến 5:00 chiều. Vào cửa trung tâm nghệ thuật miễn phí. Ngoài triển lãm của bà Alonso, các tác phẩm của một số sinh viên nghệ thuật địa phương sẽ được trưng bày tại phòng triển lãm chính của MCAC.

New Dean Appointed at Institute

YORK (17 January)—The Callard Eye Institute announced on Tuesday that Jennifer Robbins, M.D., has accepted the position of dean, effective immediately.
Dr. Robbins, who grew up in York, earned her medical degree at Labato School of Medicine and completed a postdoctoral residency at Petersen Medical Center. Before she arrived at the institute, Dr. Robbins was the founder and director of the ophthalmology clinic at Morseville Hospital. Her innovations in treating eye diseases have benefited thousands of patients worldwide.
On April 17, Dr. Robbins will be in Berlin to receive the Kramer Medal for Medical Excellence at this year's conference of the International Center for Vision Advancement.

Home | Service and Repair | Trade-in and Consignment | Accessories

Freewheel Oasis offers two programs that make selling your bicycle easier: trade-in and consignment. If you select our trade-in program, you give us your bicycle, and, in exchange, we give you credit toward the purchase of a new one. If you opt for our consignment program, we will sell your bicycle for you.

To take advantage of either option, e-mail us at programs@freewheeloasis.com to schedule an appointment. In your e-mail, you should also indicate whether you wish to trade in your bicycle or place it on consignment. You will receive a response from our customer service manager. We take appointments during regular business hours, Monday through Saturday from 9:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.

When you come in for your appointment, a technician will assess the condition of your bicycle, and a sales associate will determine its current value. If the value specified is acceptable to you and you wish to trade in your bicycle, we deduct that amount from the purchase price of your new bicycle. If you prefer a consignment arrangement, we will sell your bicycle for the agreed-upon amount. Note that we will withhold a service fee equal to 15 percent of this amount at the time your bicycle is sold, while the rest of the earnings will be sent to you.

Chúng tôi vẫn cần thêm một vài thứ cho hồ sơ nhân sự của cô. Tại buổi đào tạo nhân viên mới sáng nay, chúng tôi đã đưa cho cô một danh sách kiểm tra các giấy tờ mà chúng tôi cần lưu hồ sơ. Để cô tham khảo, tôi đã đính kèm bản quét danh sách kiểm tra của cô vào e-mail này.

Trước hết, phòng an ninh của chúng tôi yêu cầu giấy tờ chứng minh danh tính của cô. Nhân viên thường nộp bản sao bằng lái xe (mặt trước và mặt sau) hoặc trang thông tin cá nhân trong hộ chiếu, nhưng bất kỳ giấy tờ tùy thân chính thức nào do chính phủ cấp đều được chấp nhận. Chúng tôi cũng cần thông tin ngân hàng của cô để thiết lập việc chuyển khoản điện tử tiền lương vào tài khoản của cô.

Mục cuối cùng trong danh sách chỉ cần nếu cô tham gia đội bóng mềm của công ty. Cô có chơi không? Đội của công ty chúng tôi tham gia một giải đấu, và đây là cách tuyệt vời để xây dựng mối quan hệ thân thiết với những người cô sẽ làm việc cùng. Mùa giải vừa mới bắt đầu. Tôi có thể gửi chi tiết cho cô nếu cô quan tâm.

Cuối cùng, tôi muốn khuyến khích cô tham dự buổi dã ngoại của công ty, luôn được tổ chức vào thứ Sáu của tuần thứ ba trong tháng Năm tại Công viên Briarwood. Đây là cơ hội để giao lưu với đồng nghiệp trong một môi trường thân mật, không phải làm việc. Buổi dã ngoại luôn có rất đông người tham dự.

Nếu cô có bất kỳ câu hỏi nào, hãy liên hệ với tôi và chúng ta có thể sắp xếp một cuộc trò chuyện.

q57.ctx: Imagine that a transportation company is doing research in your area. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about public transportation.

qs.q: How often do you use public transportation, and where do you usually go?
qs.sample: I use public transportation about three times a week. I usually take the bus to my office downtown, and sometimes I take it to visit my parents on weekends because parking there is difficult.

qs.q: How long does it usually take you to get to work or school?
qs.sample: It usually takes me around forty minutes by bus. If the traffic is heavy in the morning, it can take almost an hour, so I always try to leave home before seven.

qs.q: What is one thing that would encourage more people in your city to use public transportation? Why?
qs.sample: I think more frequent buses would make a big difference. Right now, people often wait twenty minutes or more, so many of them prefer to ride a motorbike instead. If buses came every five or ten minutes, commuting would be much more convenient and predictable. Also, it would help reduce traffic jams and air pollution, which are serious problems in my city.

q810.intro: Hi, this is Daniel Brooks. I'm registered for the marketing conference next week, but I lost my copy of the program. I'm hoping you can answer a few questions for me.

info.title: Regional Digital Marketing Conference
info.sub: Saturday, March 14 - Grand Plaza Hotel, Room B | Registration fee: $120 (members $90)
rows: Opening remarks - Laura Chen, Conference Director
Workshop: Social Media Advertising - Mark Davis
Lecture: Writing Effective Email Campaigns - Emily Park
Panel discussion: Trends in Online Shopping
Workshop: Measuring Website Traffic - Mark Davis

qs.q: Where is the conference being held, and what time does registration start?
qs.sample: The conference will be held at the Grand Plaza Hotel, in Room B. Registration starts at eight thirty in the morning, and breakfast will be served at the same time.

qs.q: I heard that lunch is not included, so I need to bring my own. Is that right?
qs.sample: Actually, I'm afraid that's not correct. Lunch is included in the program. It will be served at twelve thirty in the Garden Restaurant, so you don't need to bring anything.

qs.q: I'm especially interested in Mark Davis. Could you tell me about all the sessions he is leading?
qs.sample: Sure. Mark Davis is leading two sessions. The first one is a workshop on social media advertising, which starts at nine thirty in the morning. Then, in the afternoon, he'll lead another workshop at three o'clock called Measuring Website Traffic. Both are workshops, so they should be quite practical and interactive.

q11.q: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Employees work more effectively from home than in an office. Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
q11.sample: I partly agree, but overall I believe employees work more effectively in an office. First, communication is much faster when people are in the same place. If I have a question for a coworker, I can just walk to their desk and solve the problem in two minutes, instead of waiting hours for an email reply. Second, an office creates a clear boundary between work and personal life. At home, there are many distractions, like family members, housework, or the television, and it is easy to lose focus. For example, during the pandemic, I worked from home for six months. Although I saved time on commuting, I often worked late at night because my schedule became disorganized, and I felt less connected to my team. That said, working from home can be useful for tasks that need quiet concentration. Still, for most people, the office is the more productive choice.

q11.q: Some people prefer to learn new job skills from an experienced coworker. Others prefer to take a formal training course. Which do you prefer and why? Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
q11.sample: Personally, I prefer to learn new job skills from an experienced coworker. The main reason is that coworkers can teach practical knowledge that training courses usually don't cover. A course explains general theory, but a senior colleague knows the real problems in our company and how to solve them quickly. Another reason is that learning from a coworker is more flexible. I can ask questions at any time while I'm actually doing the task, instead of waiting for the next class. For example, when I started my first job as an accountant, my team leader showed me how to use our company's reporting system step by step. Within two weeks, I could prepare monthly reports on my own. I had attended a software course before, but it was too general and I forgot most of it. Of course, formal courses are useful for certificates, but for daily work, an experienced coworker is the best teacher.

q11.q: What are the advantages and disadvantages of working in an open office, where employees do not have separate rooms? Give specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
q11.sample: An open office has both advantages and disadvantages. The main advantage is better communication. Because everyone works in the same space, employees can share ideas, ask questions, and solve problems together quickly. It also helps new staff get to know their coworkers and feel like part of the team. In addition, it saves money for the company, since it needs less space and fewer walls. However, the biggest disadvantage is noise. When people are talking on the phone or chatting nearby, it is hard to concentrate on difficult tasks. There is also less privacy, so employees may feel uncomfortable having personal calls. For example, my company moved to an open office last year. At first, our team cooperated more, but many people started wearing headphones to block out noise. In my opinion, the best solution is an open office with a few quiet rooms for focused work.

q11.q: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? University students should complete an internship before they graduate. Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
q11.sample: I strongly agree that university students should complete an internship before they graduate. First, an internship gives students real work experience that they cannot get in the classroom. They learn how a company actually operates, how to communicate with coworkers, and how to manage deadlines. Second, internships make it much easier to find a job after graduation. Employers prefer candidates who already have some experience, and sometimes interns are even offered a full-time position at the same company. For example, when I was in my third year at university, I did a three-month internship at a logistics company. At first, I made many mistakes, but I gradually learned how to use their software and write professional emails. Because of that experience, I was hired by the same company right after I graduated. So, in my opinion, internships are an essential part of university education.

q11.q: Which of the following qualities is the most important for a manager to have? Good communication skills, the ability to make quick decisions, or fairness to all employees. Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
q11.sample: In my opinion, the most important quality for a manager is good communication skills. First, a manager has to explain goals and tasks clearly. If employees don't understand what they need to do, even a talented team will make mistakes and waste time. Second, good communication builds trust. When a manager listens to employees and gives helpful feedback, people feel respected and become more motivated. For example, at my previous company, we had a manager who rarely explained his decisions. As a result, we often had to redo our work, and several team members became frustrated and eventually quit. Later, a new manager joined who held short meetings every Monday to explain the weekly plan and answer our questions. Our team's performance improved a lot within just a few months. Quick decisions and fairness are also important, but without clear communication, neither of them works well.

q11.q: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Companies should allow employees to choose their own working hours. Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
q11.sample: I agree that companies should allow employees to choose their own working hours, at least to some degree. First, flexible hours help people balance work and family life. For example, a parent can start work early and leave in the afternoon to pick up their children from school, so they feel less stressed and can focus better on their tasks. Second, people are productive at different times of the day. Some employees concentrate best early in the morning, while others do their best work later. If they can choose their schedule, the company gets better results. For instance, my cousin works at a software company with flexible hours, and he says he finishes his projects faster because he works when his mind is fresh. In addition, flexible hours mean fewer people travel during rush hour, which saves commuting time. Of course, teams still need some shared hours for meetings. Even so, I believe flexible working hours benefit both employees and companies.

q11.q: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Children should learn how to use computers in primary school. Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
q11.sample: I strongly agree that children should learn how to use computers in primary school. First, computer skills are now necessary in almost every part of life. Students will need to type reports, search for information online, and send emails in high school and later at work, so it is better to start early, when they learn new things quickly. Second, learning at school is safer than learning alone at home. A teacher can show children how to protect their personal information and how to tell whether a website is reliable. For example, my younger brother had computer classes once a week in grade three. He learned to make simple presentations, and now, in middle school, he is much more confident than his classmates who never had those lessons. Of course, schools should limit screen time so children still read books and play outside. However, a few lessons each week are clearly useful.

qs.q: How many times a year do you go on vacation, and who do you usually travel with?
qs.sample: I usually go on vacation about twice a year, once in the summer and once during the Lunar New Year holiday. I normally travel with my family, but sometimes I take a short trip with my close friends from university.

qs.q: When you take a vacation, do you prefer to stay in a hotel or rent an apartment? Why?
qs.sample: I prefer to stay in a hotel because it is more convenient. The room is cleaned every day, and breakfast is usually included, so I can spend more time relaxing and sightseeing.

qs.q: What is the most important thing you consider when choosing a vacation destination? Why?
qs.sample: For me, the most important thing is the cost of the trip. I have a limited budget, so I always compare the prices of flights, hotels, and meals before I decide. For example, last year I wanted to go to Japan, but it was too expensive, so I went to Thailand instead. I had a wonderful time there, and I saved a lot of money. If a trip is affordable, I can relax and enjoy it without worrying about my expenses.

q11.q: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city? Give specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
q11.sample: Living in a big city has both advantages and disadvantages. The biggest advantage is the number of opportunities. Large cities have many companies, so it is easier to find a good job with a high salary. They also have better hospitals, universities, and entertainment, such as shopping malls, concerts, and international restaurants. For example, when I moved to Ho Chi Minh City for work, I was able to take English classes in the evening and try food from many different countries. However, there are also some serious disadvantages. First, the cost of living is very high, especially rent. I pay almost half of my salary for a small apartment. Second, big cities are crowded and noisy, and traffic jams are a daily problem. Sometimes it takes me an hour to travel just ten kilometers, and the air pollution makes me feel tired. Overall, I think a big city is a great place for young people to build their careers, but it can be stressful in the long run.

q11.q: Some people prefer to stay with one company for their whole career. Others prefer to change jobs often. Which do you think is better, and why? Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
q11.sample: In my opinion, it is better to change jobs a few times during your career, especially when you are young. First, working at different companies helps you learn a wider range of skills. Each workplace has its own systems, software, and ways of solving problems, so you become more flexible and experienced. Second, changing jobs is often the fastest way to get a higher salary and a better position. For example, my older brother worked at a small marketing agency for three years. When he moved to a larger company, his salary increased by almost thirty percent, and he became a team leader within a year. If he had stayed at his first job, he would probably still be in the same role. Of course, changing jobs too often can look bad on a resume, and staying with one company can give you stability. However, I believe moving every few years to find new challenges is the better choice for most people.

q11.q: Which of the following is the most important when choosing a job? A high salary, a convenient location, or friendly colleagues. Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
q11.sample: In my opinion, friendly colleagues are the most important thing when choosing a job. First, we spend about eight hours a day at work, which is more time than we spend with our families. If the people around us are kind and helpful, even a difficult job feels manageable. Second, good colleagues help us learn and grow. When coworkers are willing to share their knowledge, we can improve our skills much faster. For example, at my first job, the salary was not very high and the office was almost an hour from my home. However, my team was wonderful. They taught me how to use our accounting software and always helped me when I made mistakes. Because of them, I stayed at that company for three years and became much more confident. Later, I had a job with a better salary, but my coworkers were very competitive, and I felt stressed every day. essay.q: Some people prefer to work from home, while others prefer to work in an office. Which do you prefer? Give reasons or examples to support your opinion.
essay.sample:
These days, thanks to fast Internet connections and video meeting software, many companies allow their employees to work from home. Some people love this arrangement, while others still prefer going to the office every day. In my opinion, working in an office is the better choice for most people, especially for young employees, for two main reasons: it makes communication easier and it creates a healthier separation between work and personal life.

First of all, working in an office makes communication much faster and clearer. When colleagues sit near each other, they can solve small problems in a few minutes by simply walking over to a coworker's desk. At home, the same problem might require several e-mails or a scheduled video call. For example, when I started my first job at an accounting firm, I made many mistakes with our reporting software. Because my supervisor sat right next to me, she could show me the correct steps immediately. If I had been working from home, I think it would have taken me months instead of weeks to learn the system. In addition, casual conversations during lunch or coffee breaks help coworkers build trust, which makes teamwork more effective.

Second, going to an office helps people keep a clear boundary between work and their private lives. When the home becomes the workplace, it is difficult to stop working at the end of the day. Many of my friends who work remotely say that they often answer e-mails late at night or on weekends because their laptop is always on the kitchen table. On the other hand, when I leave the office at six o'clock, I feel that my workday is finished, and I can relax with my family. This separation reduces stress and actually makes me more productive the next day.

Of course, working from home has some advantages, such as saving commuting time and money. However, I believe that the benefits of an office, including better communication and a healthier work-life balance, are more important in the long run. For these reasons, I prefer to work in an office.

essay.q: Which of the following is the most important quality for a manager to have? (1) Good communication skills (2) Technical knowledge of the job (3) Fairness toward all employees. Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
essay.sample:
A manager plays a key role in the success of any team. Managers need many different qualities, such as technical knowledge, fairness, and the ability to communicate well. Although all of these qualities are valuable, I strongly believe that good communication skills are the most important for a manager. This is because clear communication helps employees understand their goals, and it also allows managers to solve problems before they become serious.

To begin with, a manager who communicates well can make sure that everyone on the team understands what to do and why. Even the most talented employees cannot perform well if their instructions are unclear. For example, at the marketing company where I used to work, we had a manager who often gave very short and confusing instructions by e-mail. As a result, two team members once spent a whole week preparing the same report, while another important task was not done at all. After a new manager joined the team, she held a short meeting every Monday to explain the weekly priorities and give each person a clear responsibility. Within a month, our team was meeting all of its deadlines.

In addition, good communication helps managers notice and solve problems early. When a manager listens carefully and talks openly with staff, employees feel comfortable sharing their concerns. For instance, an employee might mention that a client is unhappy or that a project needs more time. A manager who encourages this kind of honest conversation can take action quickly, perhaps by calling the client or adjusting the schedule. On the other hand, if a manager is difficult to talk to, employees may hide their problems until it is too late.

Some people may argue that technical knowledge is more important, because a manager must understand the work. However, a manager can always ask experienced team members for technical advice. Fairness is also essential, but even a fair decision can cause anger if it is not explained well. In conclusion, I believe that communication skills are the most important quality for a manager, because they help the whole team work efficiently and handle difficulties successfully.

essay.q: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? University students should be required to complete an internship before they graduate. Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
essay.sample:
Every year, millions of university students graduate and begin looking for their first job. Many of them, however, find that employers want people who already have work experience. For this reason, some people believe that universities should require students to complete an internship before graduation. I completely agree with this idea, because internships help students apply what they have learned and make it easier for them to find a job.

First, an internship gives students a chance to use their classroom knowledge in a real workplace. At university, students mostly read textbooks and take exams, but they rarely see how theories work in practice. For example, my cousin studied business administration and learned a lot about marketing strategies. However, during his three-month internship at a cosmetics company, he discovered that real marketing also requires talking to customers, working with tight budgets, and changing plans quickly. He told me that he learned more in those three months than in a full year of lectures. Experiences like this help students understand which skills they still need to improve before they graduate.

Second, internships make it much easier for graduates to get a job. Employers prefer applicants who already know how to behave professionally, write business e-mails, and work in a team. A student who has completed an internship can show these abilities on a résumé and talk about them in an interview. In addition, many companies hire their best interns as full-time employees. In fact, one of my former classmates received a job offer from the bank where she worked as an intern, even before her graduation ceremony. Without the internship requirement, she might never have applied there.

Some people argue that required internships put too much pressure on students who already have heavy course loads or part-time jobs. This is a fair concern, but universities can solve it by offering internships during summer vacation or giving course credit for them. In conclusion, I firmly believe that internships should be required, because they connect education with the real world and give students a strong start to their careers.

essay.q: What are the advantages and disadvantages of companies using social media to advertise their products? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
essay.sample:
Today, almost every company, from small coffee shops to large international brands, uses social media to advertise its products. Platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok allow businesses to reach millions of people quickly. While social media advertising has clear advantages, such as low cost and direct contact with customers, it also has some serious disadvantages, including the risk of negative publicity.

The biggest advantage of social media advertising is that it is cheap and can target the right customers. In the past, companies had to pay large amounts of money for television or newspaper advertisements, which were seen by many people who had no interest in the product. Now, a business can spend only a small amount and show its advertisements to a specific group, such as young parents living in one city. For example, a small bakery near my home started posting photos and short videos of its cakes on Facebook. Within a few months, its number of customers almost doubled, even though it spent very little on advertising. Another advantage is that companies can communicate directly with customers by answering their questions and comments, which helps build loyalty.

However, social media advertising also has disadvantages. The most important one is that bad news spreads very quickly online. If a customer has a bad experience and posts an angry review or video, thousands of people may see it within a single day. For instance, a restaurant in my city lost many customers after someone shared a video of slow service, even though the problem happened only once. In addition, managing social media accounts takes a lot of time and effort. Companies must post new content regularly and reply to messages quickly, so they often need to hire extra staff.

In conclusion, social media gives companies an affordable and effective way to reach customers and build relationships with them. At the same time, it can quickly damage a company's reputation and requires constant attention. I believe that the advantages are greater than the disadvantages, but only if companies plan carefully and respond to problems honestly and quickly.

essay.q: Some people prefer to work for a large company, while others prefer to work for a small company. Which would you prefer? Give reasons or examples to support your opinion.
essay.sample:
When people look for a job, one important decision is whether to join a large company or a small one. Large companies often offer stability and famous names, while small companies offer a more personal environment. Personally, I would prefer to work for a small company, because I could learn a wider range of skills and my contributions would be noticed more easily.

The main reason I prefer a small company is that employees there usually have the chance to do many different tasks. In a large company, each person often has a narrow role and repeats the same work every day. In a small company, however, there are fewer workers, so each person must help in many areas. For example, my friend works at a small travel agency with only twelve employees. Although she was hired as a sales assistant, she also writes posts for the company's website, talks with hotel partners, and sometimes helps with accounting. After two years, she has gained so much experience that she feels confident about starting her own business in the future. I believe this kind of broad experience is very valuable, especially at the beginning of a career.

Another reason is that, in a small company, hard work is recognized more quickly. Because the company is small, the director knows every employee personally and can see who is doing a good job. As a result, employees who work hard may be promoted faster or receive more responsibility. On the other hand, in a large corporation with thousands of workers, it is easy to feel like a small part of a big machine. My uncle worked for a large bank for six years before he was given his first promotion, even though his performance was excellent.

It is true that large companies often pay higher salaries and offer better benefits, such as health insurance and training programs. However, I think the chance to develop many skills and to be valued as an individual is more important for long-term success and job satisfaction. For these reasons, I would choose to work for a small company.

essay.q: Some people prefer to save their money for the future, while others prefer to spend it on experiences such as travel or concerts. Which do you prefer? Give reasons or examples to support your opinion.
essay.sample:
Money is limited for most people, so everyone has to decide how to use it. Some people put as much as possible into a savings account, while others enjoy spending their money on experiences such as traveling, concerts, or learning new hobbies. In my opinion, saving money for the future is the wiser choice, especially for young people, for two main reasons: it provides security in difficult times and it creates more opportunities later in life.

First of all, savings protect people when unexpected problems happen. Life is unpredictable, and anyone can lose a job, get sick, or face a large repair bill. For example, two years ago my father's company closed suddenly, and he was unemployed for almost five months. Because my parents had saved part of their income every month for many years, our family could still pay the rent and my school fees without borrowing money. If they had spent everything on vacations, that period would have been extremely stressful. Having savings allows people to stay calm and make good decisions instead of panicking.

Second, saving money today creates bigger opportunities in the future. A person who saves regularly can eventually buy a home, start a small business, or pay for a master's degree. These goals can change a person's whole life, while a concert or a weekend trip only lasts a short time. For instance, one of my friends saved money for four years instead of traveling with our group. Last year, she used her savings to open a small coffee shop, and now she earns more than any of us. In addition, people who save can still enjoy experiences later, when they can afford them without worrying.

Of course, experiences are also valuable, and spending a little on travel can reduce stress and create happy memories. However, I believe that the security and long-term opportunities that come from saving are more important. For these reasons, I prefer to save my money for the future.

essay.q: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Technology has made people less social. Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
essay.sample:
Today, most people carry a smartphone everywhere, and they spend hours each day on social media, messaging apps, and online games. Some people believe that these technologies have made us less social, because we look at screens instead of talking to each other. Although I understand this concern, I disagree with the statement. In my opinion, technology has actually helped people stay connected and build new relationships.

First of all, technology makes it easy to keep in touch with people who live far away. In the past, when someone moved to another city or country, friends and family could only send letters or make expensive phone calls. Now, we can talk on video calls for free whenever we want. For example, my older sister has been studying in Australia for three years. Thanks to video calls, our family has dinner with her online every Sunday evening, and she still feels close to us even though she is thousands of kilometers away. Without technology, our relationship would be much weaker.

Second, the Internet helps people find others who share their interests. Many people, especially shy people, find it difficult to start conversations with strangers. Online groups give them a comfortable way to meet new friends. My friend Tuan, for instance, joined an online running group last year. At first, he only chatted with the members on the app, but soon he started joining their weekend runs in the park. Now he has a large group of friends that he meets in person every week. In this case, technology did not replace real-life friendships; it created them.

Of course, technology can be misused. Some people check their phones during meals or spend too much time online alone. However, this is a problem of personal habits, not of technology itself. If we use our devices wisely, they can bring us closer together. For these reasons, I do not believe that technology has made people less social.

I have two questions about the EC-300 model. First, how much more expensive is it, and could you offer us a discount since the original model is not available? Second, if we choose the EC-300, how soon can you deliver all twenty chairs to our office?

Please reply at your earliest convenience so that we can make a decision quickly.

Sincerely,
Mai Vo

essay.q: When hiring new employees, some companies prefer people who already have work experience, while others prefer to hire recent graduates and train them. Which approach do you think is better? Give reasons or examples to support your opinion.
essay.sample:
Every company wants to hire the best possible employees, but there are different opinions about who those employees are. Some managers believe that experienced workers are the safest choice, while others prefer to hire recent graduates and train them from the beginning. In my opinion, hiring recent graduates and training them is the better approach for most companies, for two main reasons: graduates bring fresh ideas, and they can be trained to fit the company's own way of working.

First of all, recent graduates often bring new energy and modern knowledge to a company. Because they have just finished their studies, they are familiar with the latest technology and trends. For example, at the company where my sister works, the marketing department hired two young graduates last year. They quickly suggested using short videos on social media to promote the company's products, and within six months, online sales increased by almost thirty percent. The older staff members had not considered this idea because they were used to traditional advertising.

Second, training new graduates allows a company to shape employees according to its own culture and methods. Experienced workers sometimes have habits from their previous jobs that are difficult to change. In contrast, graduates are usually eager to learn and open to feedback. When I started my first job at a bank, I had no experience at all, but the bank gave me three months of training. As a result, I learned exactly how the bank wanted me to serve customers, and I felt very loyal to the company because it had invested in me. In fact, I worked there for five years.

Of course, hiring experienced employees has some advantages. They can start working immediately, and the company does not need to spend money on long training programs. However, I believe that the long-term benefits of hiring graduates, including fresh ideas, flexibility, and loyalty, are more valuable than these short-term savings. For these reasons, I think companies should hire recent graduates and train them.
essay.outline:

essay.q: Some people think governments should spend more money on public parks. Others think governments should spend more money on roads. Which do you think is more important? Give reasons or examples to support your opinion.
essay.sample:
Every government has a limited budget, so it must decide carefully where to spend public money. Some people believe that parks are a better investment, while others argue that roads should come first. In my opinion, governments should spend more money on public parks, because parks improve people's health and help build stronger communities.

First of all, public parks have a direct effect on people's physical and mental health. In many modern cities, people spend most of their day sitting in offices or cars, and they rarely get enough exercise. A large, well-maintained park gives everyone a free place to jog, ride a bicycle, or simply walk after work. For example, a few years ago, my city turned an empty lot near my neighborhood into a small park with walking paths and exercise equipment. Now, every morning and evening, I see dozens of people of all ages exercising there, including my parents, who used to stay at home watching television. Green spaces also reduce stress and give people a break from noise and pollution.

Second, parks bring people together. In big cities, neighbors often do not know each other because everyone is busy. Parks provide a place where children can play together, families can have picnics, and local groups can hold festivals or concerts. These activities create a sense of community, which makes neighborhoods safer and friendlier. Roads, on the other hand, mainly help people move from one place to another, but they do not encourage people to stop and connect.

Of course, good roads are necessary for the economy, and traffic jams are a serious problem in many cities. However, building more roads often just encourages more people to drive, so the traffic soon returns. In contrast, the benefits of parks last for generations. For these reasons, I believe governments should focus more of their budget on public parks.

essay.q: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Students should be required to wear school uniforms. Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
essay.sample:
In many countries, students are required to wear school uniforms, while in others they can choose their own clothes. Some people believe uniforms limit students' freedom, but I strongly agree that students should wear school uniforms. In my view, uniforms reduce pressure among students and help them focus on their studies.

First of all, school uniforms reduce social pressure and differences between students. Teenagers often judge each other by their appearance. If students could wear anything they wanted, those from wealthy families might wear expensive brand-name clothes, while others might feel embarrassed about their simple outfits. For example, my cousin studies at a school with no uniform policy, and she told me that some classmates are teased because they wear the same clothes several times a week. At my high school, by contrast, everyone wore the same white shirt and dark blue trousers, so nobody paid attention to what others were wearing. As a result, we made friends based on personality rather than money.

Second, uniforms help students concentrate on learning and save time. When students do not have to choose an outfit every morning, they can get ready quickly and arrive at school on time. Moreover, wearing a uniform creates a serious atmosphere, similar to how employees in many companies wear suits or work clothes. When I put on my uniform, I felt that it was time to study, and I believe this habit helped me stay disciplined. Parents also benefit, because buying a few uniforms is usually cheaper than buying many fashionable clothes throughout the year.

Of course, some people argue that uniforms prevent students from expressing their personalities. However, students can still show their creativity through their ideas, hobbies, and school activities, and they can wear what they like on weekends. For these reasons, I believe that requiring school uniforms is a good policy for most schools.
